text:
Maya (Security): Heads up — staging auditlog ingest latency spiking during a KMS rotation smoke. Need quick triage: owners, blockers, and ETA for mitigation. cc @Liam @Omar @Sofia

Liam (Infra): Saw it earlier. Correlating with keystore rotation window — S3 puts are getting 500s for ~30s bursts. Reproducing now with a short rotation in nonprod.

Denise (Product): Does this affect the fieldwork sampling? Auditors are scheduled next Wed and we planned to use staging sample ingest for the dry run.

Maya (Security): Yes, could block the sample handoff if not mitigated. Two asks: (1) quick rollback/fallback plan for rotation, (2) who owns the ingest client to add retry/backoff and tighter metrics.

Omar (DevEx): ingest-service owns the client (I've got PR history). I can open a patch to add exponential backoff + circuit-breaker with a short TTL.

Liam (Infra): Pls also check if the keystore rotation is triggering a transient KMS permission refresh in the sidecars. That would explain the 500s. I'm going to capture logs and push to the incident channel.

DeployBot: staging/ingest-service redeploy v2026.03.18-rc2 started by @Liam

Omar (DevEx): Quick mitigation option: toggle rotation off for the next scheduled window so ingest can catch up. Config flag we can flip: 
```
ENV_DISABLE_KMS_ROTATION=true
```
I can open the PR to support that toggle and wire a rollout in staging.

Sofia (Compliance): If we flip rotation, we need to log that change as a temporary deviation in the evidence tracker and note owner+duration. Auditors will want traceability.

Maya (Security): Agreed. I'll create a JIRA INF-4321 (KMS rotation transient causing ingest latency) and add remediation timeline. Tagging @Sofia to update the evidence sheet and @Denise for fieldwork acceptance criteria.

Denise (Product): If the ingest patch adds retries, what's the risk to latency SLAs for user traffic? We need to ensure we don't push bad latency to production.

Omar (DevEx): We'll scope retries to internal audit ingest route only (short TTL) and expose metrics: ingest.retry.count, ingest.kms.errors. No change to public API paths.

Liam (Infra): Collected logs: s3.putObject 500s during rotation window, sidecar auth error TTL=18s. Pushing filtered logs to the compliance share.

Maya (Security): Plan of record for now: (A) Omar opens PR for targeted retries + toggle (ETA EOD tomorrow), (B) Liam posts log dump and a proposed playbook step to temporarily disable rotation if bursts happen (ETA 4h), (C) Sofia updates evidence doc and adds a note referencing INF-4321 (ETA immediate). If anyone objects to that plan speak now.

Omar (DevEx): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/injest-service/pull/214 — includes backoff, feature flag, and metrics. Marked @Liam for infra smoke and @Maya for security review.

Sofia (Compliance): Updated evidence sheet (link: https://docs.redwood.com/compliance/evidence) with the deviation note and provisional mitigation window. Added auditors' dry-run impact note.

Liam (Infra): I tested the PR in staging with flag enabled — SP spikes reduced, no 500s during our test rotation. Will schedule a short rotation replay in 30m with @Omar to validate.

Maya (Security): Perfect. I'll close the loop in INF-4321 after the replay and record the final decision for the dry-run. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
